global.title: Jamming created a resilience market. The space industry is losing it to the ground.
global.summary: In the first quarter of this year, roughly 978,000 maritime GPS jamming events were recorded worldwide. Ninety-eight percent of them happened in one place: the Middle East Gulf. It is the largest single-quarter concentration of maritime jamming ever recorded, and more than 1,100 vessels in the region were affected.
